correctness.rationale: From Tian Theorem 4.1’s exact qualitative criterion for this positive noncommuting 2x2 domain, X+Y ⪰ I, write X=I-uP,Y=I-vQ with rank-one lower-eigenvalue projectors P,Q and overlap z∈(0,1). The larger eigenvalue of uP+vQ <=1 iff uv z²<=lambda mu, a necessary-and-sufficient bound. Direct matrix multiplication gives ||[X,Y]||=uv z sqrt(1-z²); optimize z² at min(lambda mu/(uv),1/2) to derive the two stated branches. Inequality sqrt((u-v)²+4uv z²)>=(u+v)z and AM–GM give uv<=(1+z)^(-2); maximum z=1/2, u=v=2/3 gives 1/(3sqrt3) with the stated semidefinite C witness. Independently computed feasible 2x2 projection matrices and commutator norm across 36 eigenratio pairs, including strict X,Y positivity and exact global witness. Important external dependency is the fully inspected Tian criterion, not inferred from grid computations.
